newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks extend recovery into second day.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks extend recovery into second day.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks eked out a small gain Tuesday, extending their recovery from Friday's sell-off, but the upward momentum was tempered by a late retreat in high-flying technology shares.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 9.31 points at 6,473.25 after racking up a mid-afternoon gain of nearly 50 points. The technology-laden Nasdaq Composite index was off 3.71 points at 1,312.56, one day after closing at a new high.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on active volume of 450 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
